description: A pattern detector. Module `seq1011` with inputs clk, rst_n (active-low reset) and din, and output found. din is sampled at each rising clock edge. found is 1 for the clock cycle right after the edge that samples the last bit of the pattern 1, 0, 1, 1, and 0 otherwise. Overlapping patterns count (1011011 finds two). found comes from a register; reset clears it and forgets earlier bits.

starter.title: Pattern detector
starter.summary: Watches a serial input and signals each time it sees the bit pattern 1011.
